IN TERMS OF THE CONTINGENCY FEES ACT, 1997 (ACT 66 OF 1997)
The client and attorney conclude this fee agreement for purposes of the client’s third party claim
to a motor vehicle accident that occurred on _
He/she was advised of other ways of financing the litigation and attorney’s costs of this
matter, for example, borrowing funds from a financial institution or elsewhere;
He/she was informed of the normal rule that in the event of him, her or it being unsuccessful
in the proceedings, he, she or it may be liable to pay the taxed party and party costs of his,
her or its opponent in the proceedings;
He/she was informed that he, she or it will also be liable to pay the success fee in the event
He/she understood the meaning and purport of the agreement.
Now therefore the parties wish to come to an agreement in terms of the Contingency Fees Act.
By his signature hereto the attorney warrants that in his opinion there are reasonable
prospects that the client may be successful in the proceedings;
The client acknowledges that he/she gave a written power of attorney to the attorney to:
conduct proceedings in/before the High Court to act on his/her behalf;
render professional services, namely all professional services associated with
conducting a civil trial in a claim for damages as a result of injuries sustained in a
motor vehicle collision, claimed from the Road Accident Fund;
appoint a correspondent or correspondents to act on his/her behalf;
appoint an advocate or advocates to act on his/her behalf;
The attorney accepts the instruction to act for the client on the understanding that he will be
entitled to the payment of fees only in the following circumstances:
if the client is successful or partially successful in the proceedings;
if a costs order in favour of the client is made or agreed to by all the parties
if costs are recovered from the party/parties against whom the costs order was
made or who agreed to pay the client’s costs.
In the event of the premature termination of this agreement for any reason whatsoever, by
the attorney, the attorney will not be entitled to payment of his fees.  The client will be liable
In the event of the termination of the attorney’s mandate by the client, the attorney will be
entitled to his normal fees plus 100% for work done, payable within one (1) year after
In the event of successful finalisation of the claim, the attorney will be entitled to his normal
fee plus a success fee amounting to 100% (as set out in Annexure “A” hereto) of the
fee but subject to the terms of clause 7.
It is agreed and understood between the parties that the success fee shall not:
exceed the attorney’s normal fees by more than 100% (as set out in Annexure “A”
in the case of a claim sounding in money, exceed 25% of the total amount
or any amount obtained by the client in consequence of the proceedings.
purpose of calculating the higher fee, costs are not included), whichever is
It is recorded and agreed that the attorney’s normal fee, also referred to as
and own client fees, as at the date of signature hereof will be charged
The hourly rates of the attorney, candidate attorney and/or paralegal as referred to
in paragraph 8.1 above, will be subject to a 10% annual escalation from 1 January
The parties agree that the client shall be deemed to be successful or partially successful in
the aforementioned proceedings if any award of damages is made in favour of the client or
if an agreement is reached with the opposing party that any amount be paid to the client in
respect of his/her claim for damages.
The client will be liable for disbursements paid by the attorney on his/her behalf, whether
matter is successful or not. No surcharge will be levied against disbursements.
If the capital amount is paid out by the Road Accident Fund, the attorney is entitled to
deduct all disbursements and his/her fees while awaiting payment of the bill of costs by the
The client has a period of fourteen (14) days, calculated from the date of signing this
agreement, during which he/she will have the right to withdraw from the agreement by
notice to the attorney in writing.
The attorney shall, in the event of withdrawal by the client, be entitled to fees and
disbursements in respect of any necessary or essential work done to protect the interests
the client during such period, calculated on an attorney and client basis.
If the client feels aggrieved by any provision of this agreement or any fees chargeable in
terms of this agreement, the agreement or the fees may be referred for review to the
Pretoria Law Society of which the attorney is a member. The professional controlling body
concerned may set aside any provisions of this agreement or any fees claimable in terms
this agreement if in its opinion such provisions or fees are unreasonable or unjust.
Any amendment or other agreements ancillary to this agreement (including any
amendments to such agreements) shall be in writing and comply with the requirements laid
down in the Contingency Fees Act, 1997 (Act No. 66 of 1997). A copy of any such
amendment or other agreements ancillary to this agreement shall be delivered to the client
upon the date on which such amendment or ancillary agreement is signed.
